manual_rationale: Every induced obligation has timely admissible success evidence.
One obligation succeeds and the other has an authenticated unexpired policy-authorised exception.
Exactly one of two obligations has an admissible resolution.
The deadline passed with no admissible resolution.
Two admissible assertions give incompatible dispositions for the same obligation.
The obligation-set commitment is invalid so the evaluation baseline is not verifiable.
The deadline has not passed and early closure is not permitted.
Closure is correct only relative to the authenticated observable graph; the perfectly hidden derivative is unknowable.
Authenticated disclosure expands reachability and induces an unresolved second obligation.
The success assertion is observable but its event time is later than the obligation deadline.
The asserted exception is not issued by an admitted exception authority.
Missing predecessor material breaks evidence continuity and makes the receipt inadmissible.
The policy permits early closure and every obligation already has a terminal success report.
The authenticated no-applicable-obligations determination makes empty closure non-vacuous.
An empty set without an authenticated no-applicable determination cannot establish the baseline.
The evidence-relative model accepts a valid signed assertion and cannot infer contrary physical state.
